headline: Trump's Russia diesel waiver and Ukraine refinery strikes jolt fuel markets
intro: Diesel's been the inflation story nobody wanted, and now geopolitics is piling on — Trump cut a deal to keep Russian diesel flowing even as Ukraine lit up a St. Petersburg refinery over the weekend. Crude opened soft Monday, but the real action is in the barrel breakdown.
overview: Oil futures eased Monday as traders weighed the prospect of increased Russian supply against lingering Middle East risk, after Trump confirmed a diesel-focused deal with Russia meant to keep peace talks alive — a move Sen. Ted Cruz called a mistake benefiting Putin. Ukraine's drone strikes on a St. Petersburg refinery over the weekend underscore how fragile that arrangement looks. On the policy side, EPA floated reallocating over 770 million RIN credits tied to small refinery exemptions, DOE opened a new 45Z pathway for biofuels outside standard emissions tables, and USDA's soybean-oil forecast implies another 600M+ D4 RINs — all while refiners like Valero head toward blowout quarters on diesel cracks still above $6.

stories.title: Trump Says Diesel Deal Aims to Keep Russia Talks Going
stories.summary: Trump said he cut a diesel export deal with Russia and delayed further sanctions to keep Putin engaged in peace talks.

stories.title: Ted Cruz Torches Trump Waiving Russia Sanctions as a ‘Mistake’ That ‘Benefits Putin’
stories.summary: Sen. Ted Cruz criticized Trump's waiving of Russia sanctions as a mistake that benefits Putin.

stories.title: Ukraine drone strike hits St Petersburg refinery after Trump's cease-fire
stories.summary: Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack on St. Petersburg, sparking fires at a refinery and fuel depot despite Trump's proposed energy ceasefire.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Petroleum Futures Fall on Prospect of Increased Russian Supply -- OPIS
stories.summary: Petroleum futures fell Monday on the prospect of increased Russian supply, though declines were limited by lingering supply concerns, per OPIS.

stories.title: Oil Eases as Traders Assess Supply Risks, Sanctions Waiver
stories.summary: Oil eased Monday as traders weighed Middle East supply risks against a new sanctions waiver.

stories.title: Oil Opens Soft Despite Escalating Supply Threats
stories.summary: Energy markets opened softer but quiet Monday following a strong reversal higher to close out last week.

stories.title: Valero Heads for a Likely Record Quarter as Diesel Stays Above $6
stories.summary: Valero heads toward a likely record quarter as diesel stays above $6/gal, with Wall Street expecting roughly $21/share.

stories.title: Why Diesel, Not Crude, Is the Real Inflation Signal Right Now
stories.summary: Diesel prices, with global supply 1.7M b/d below last year, are emerging as a bigger inflation signal than crude, per the piece.

stories.title: Exxon's Refining Windfall Is Real. It's Still the Wrong Reason to Chase the Stock.
stories.summary: ExxonMobil's refining segment added a reported $4.5B profit boost in Q3, though overall earnings rose only $0.4B on upstream and shipping drags.

stories.title: Reallocation plan offers relief for ethanol producers, farmers
stories.summary: EPA is proposing to reallocate more than 770 million renewable fuel blending credits tied to small refinery exemptions.

stories.title: DOE Gives More Biofuels a Path Toward 45Z
stories.summary: DOE created a new pathway for biofuel producers to qualify for the 45Z clean fuel tax credit even without a listed emissions pathway.

stories.title: USDA soybean-oil forecast implies roughly 600 million additional D4 RINs
stories.summary: USDA's latest soybean-oil demand forecast implies roughly 600-630 million additional D4 RINs, per Fastmarkets analysis.

stories.title: Europe takes China’s used cooking oil, the US takes Australia’s tallow
stories.summary: Shifting feedstock trade flows: China's UCO exports to Europe are up sharply while the US increasingly sources tallow from Australia as Brazil's shipments drop on tariffs.

stories.title: LanzaJet secures financing to scale SAF production, supply global customers
stories.summary: LanzaJet secured new financing, backed by LanzaTech Global and Vinod Khosla, to scale SAF production, with full close expected by December.
